Synopsis:
You talk to a shadar-kai from the shadowfell. He tasks you with collecting memories from the dead.

Cluster Contexts:
- SCL_ServantOfTheRaven_ShadarKai.json: You have just used Speak with Dead on a fresh corpse while a shadar‑kai — cold, raven‑companioned, and acting as an agent of the Raven Queen — watches and speaks to you. He asks you to become the dead’s “voice,” to collect a record or memories written in the victim’s own hand so he can summon and put the spirit on trial. In exchange he hints he can share or teach the shadowy rites to bind and question the dead, but his motives are opaque and he may be manipulating your desire for vengeance. The corpse’s answers will be short, fractured, and unreliable, and fulfilling this task likely requires searching for documents or performing rites amid the recent aftermath of violence.
- CRA_DeadPrisoner_Dead.json: You have cast Speak with Dead on a merchant named Francis who was abducted by mindflayers during the shipwreck and later died in the crash; his corpse is before you and he appears as a weak, pallid shade. His replies are halting and fragmentary, limited to things he felt at the end—tentacles dragging him, “something” put in his eye, fire, screaming, and the crushing impact. The conversation assumes you already recovered his body and may offer burial or last rites, but the spirit rebukes such comforts and won’t sustain long explanations or new details. Expect gaps, broken hints, and short, choking answers rather than a full account.
- SCL_ServantOfTheRaven_Raven.json: You talk to a Raven in the shadow-cursed lands. Part of the Servant of the Raven booster.
- HAV_CursedFist_Dead_CursedFist.json: You have used Speak with Dead on Art Cullagh — a Flaming Fist who was sent to investigate Ketheric Thorm and was trapped in the Shadowfell for roughly a century. The session is meant to prod hints about how to lift his curse, but like other Speak with Dead encounters here his replies are lifeless, halting, and fragmentary rather than coherent testimony. Off‑screen this ties into recent/in-progress activity around Moonrise Towers and the Sharran/Absolute threat, and Art’s broken lines name “curse,” “darkness,” and plea for “Thaniel,” implying a person who might be central to helping him. Expect gaps, contradictions, and only partial leads rather than a full, reliable explanation.
- LOW_PhilgravesMansion_DeadAdventurer_Dead.json: Speak with dead dialog with a dead adventurer in the ancient lair
